To modify, update the template and regenerate.
Junction table linking images to tags. An image carries any number of
tags, and a tag classifies any number of images. The association itself
has no natural key: a row is identified by the image and tag pair it
links, and the row records who made the association and when.
AUTO-GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
To modify, update the template and regenerate.
An image is a named document the platform renders, such as a currency flag
or a commodity icon. The bytes are format-agnostic: an SVG document, a
JPEG, or any other media type mime_type names. The database stores them
base64-encoded in a text column, and the domain type carries the raw
bytes. Images carry tags through the image_tag junction, and an image
arrives either by upload or from the data-quality publish path.
AUTO-GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT MANUALLY
To modify, update the template and regenerate.
A tag classifies an image. A tag belongs to one tenant, names a single
category such as flag, currency or commodity, and its name is unique
within that tenant. Images carry tags through the image_tag junction, so
a tag has no lifecycle of its own beyond its own version history.
Index and the other groups: ores_schema.puml
